description: List the dimensions of any SNB data-portal cube and the item ids in each (e.g. devkum: D0 = monthly average 'M0' / end of month 'M1', D1 = currency 'EUR1', 'USD1', 'JPY100', …). Use the ids in get_snb_data's dimension_selection to fetch only the series you need. Examples: cube_id='devkum', cube_id='zimoma'.

cube_id.description: SNB cube id, e.g. 'devkum' (monthly FX), 'zimoma' (money market rates); see list_snb_datasets

language.description: Label language: en or de (default en)

name: get_snb_cube_dimensions
title: SNB cube dimensions
